$Comment: Falling iceberg. Copy of vanilla Projectile_Config_Stalactite: spawned on the ground by the encounter (SpawnInteraction), SpawnOffset Z 25 along a -90 pitch puts it 25 blocks up, it falls at LaunchForce 13 (about 2 s) with no gravity, and hits every entity in a 2.3-block circle (HitEntity as the nova; ice creatures with AT_Ice_King_Ice_Body take no damage and Immunity_Freeze stops the freeze) (the vanilla stalactite range, so the vanilla Stalactite_Ground_Indicator telegraph matches it). 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): Iceberg_Impact when it lands, on the ground or on an entity. 2026-10-22: the solid iceberg test (an invisible HardCollision deployable beside the pillar) is removed (playtest: annoying, and it outlived the pillar); only the NPC pillar again.

Interactions.$Comment: Leave an ice pillar where it landed: cover against arrows and rays, breakable, melts after 10 s. Single-entity SpawnNPC form of vanilla Block_Coffin_Open, AllowMidAirSpawn from Cocoon_Spider_Cave_Spawn. The pillar hitbox reaches 1.7 below its origin and the iceberg ends half buried, so offsets 0 and 1.8 failed with 'there isn't enough space' (2026-10-19); at 3.5 it spawns in the air and its Fly controller lowers it to 1.7 over the ground. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the pillars float far above the ground): SpawnOffset Y 1 (was 3.5 = half a block over the hit block). The 3.5 dated from the old hitbox that reached 1.7 below the origin; the pillar hitbox now starts at the feet (Y 0..0.78 x2.5), and its Fly controller with BodyMotion Nothing does not bring it down, so it stayed where it spawned.

2026-10-22: wait before RemoveEntity. The Selector's HitEntity runs as forked chains on the owner (the king) with this projectile as their entity; once the projectile is gone a fork still running (DamageEntity takes 2 ticks, the freeze path ~0.2 s) is cancelled every tick but never removed (InteractionManager.doTickChain throws ChainCancelledException with the chain's own NotFinished state), so the king kept an open chain forever and every rule waiting for IsExecutingInteraction false (air attacks, orbit, phase change) froze. Found with Mob Battle's /mobbattle test chains.
